component.name: com.hyland.openarch.ecm.core.DocumentEnrichmentService
component.documentation: Invoked when a document is created or updated, immediately alongside the sys_modified stamping and within the same transaction, so downstream distributions (e.g. the enterprise distribution) can contribute pluggable logic. Community registers no enrichers by default.

extension-point.name: enrichers
extension-point.documentation: Register a com.hyland.openarch.ecm.core.api.DocumentEnricher to run custom logic on document create/update.
